title: Mailing
description:
A complete mailing: one theme applied to an ordered list of emails
on one format.

emails.description:
Emails in send order. One email is a single send; two or more
are a sequence.

format.description: The format every email is laid out on. Absent means standard.

outline.description:
The email titles of the complete mailing, in order. A preview
mailing lists more titles than it has emails: the app continues
it from this list later. Leave it empty when the mailing is
complete.

theme.description: Visual identity applied to every email.

title.description: Mailing title, shown in the editor. Not rendered on an email.

Email.description:
One email: an HTML fragment for the mailing's format, CSS for that
fragment, and author notes.

css.description:
CSS for this email only. The server scopes every selector to
this email. Use plain selectors such as `.title` or `h1`. Use the
theme through `var(--background)`, `var(--text)`, `var(--accent)`,
`var(--muted)`, `var(--heading-font)`, `var(--body-font)`,
`var(--mono-font)`. No `@import`, no viewport units, no `<`.

html.description:
The email as one HTML fragment. The canvas is the mailing's `format` in px, 600 wide: 600 by 800 for short, 600 by 1200 for standard, 600 by 1800 for long. Use px units. Allowed: headings, text, lists, tables, `` with `src="/uploads/{name}"`, inline `
`, `
`, ``. Not
allowed: `

notes.description:
Author notes: the subject line and the preheader text, as a
`Subject:` line and a `Preheader:` line, plus intent or handoff
remarks. Never rendered on the email and never exported.

EmailFormat.description:
The canvas an email is laid out on. Every format is 600 px wide,
the email-client column; the formats differ in height.

body.description: Family for every other text element that sets no font.

heading.description: Family for text elements with role `title` or `heading`.

accent.description: Color for highlights, shapes, and chart series that set no color.

background.description: Screen background color when a screen sets no background.

muted.description: Secondary color for captions, rules, and table stripes.

text.description: Text color when an element sets no color.

Theme.description:
Default colors and fonts that elements inherit when they omit their
own.

name.description: Theme name shown in the editor.
